title: SF2601 (2017-2018 Regular): Semiautomatic firearm slide-fire stock defined as trigger activator

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/SF/2601/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced text (no date given). Words added to existing law are not marked in the text file; the sentence quoted is the one the bill title says it adds. No votes recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 1): For purposes of this section, a device that is designed to use the recoil of a semiautomatic firearm to enable a shooter to fire multiple shots in rapid succession, commonly known as a slide-fire or bump-fire stock, is a trigger activator.
